- Use exact strings/numbers from invoice; do not infer currency conversion or alter values beyond required numeric formatting.
- Keep decimal precision as in source (two decimals).
- If any field is ambiguous or missing, leave as empty string.

4) Multiple occurrences
- VAT appears as single group; will output one VAT entry.
